source_refs.locator: Section ‘Fortalecimiento de capacidades a municipios vulnerables’; paragraphs beginning ‘Descripción’ and ‘Actualmente se ha desarrollado la metodología’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: MiAmbiente reports a vulnerability-index method and two capacity workshops completed with the initially selected municipalities, including Las Palmas (Veraguas) and Chame (Panamá Oeste); maps are intended to distinguish corregimientos and inform local planning.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: The ministry describes a Kusapín, Ngäbe-Buglé pilot involving local, government and traditional authorities and proposing gender-aware vulnerability mapping, participatory land-use planning, climate-risk management and local planner training.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Water-programme section, paragraphs beginning ‘Para hacer esto’ and ‘En paralelo’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: The programme says climate-informed water-right decisions aim to strengthen governance in two basins selected partly due to existing water-user conflicts.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Opening results paragraphs beginning ‘El programa…’ and ‘Panamá cuenta…’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2023-06-27 reports: MiAmbiente reports over 116,000 direct and indirect beneficiaries across the climate-vulnerable Chiriquí Viejo and Santa María basins; consultations raised crop-loss, extreme-event and drinking-water quantity and quality concerns.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Results obtained, Result 1, paragraph beginning ‘El programa implementó’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2023-06-27 reports: The ministry reports adaptation practices on 120 farms covering 600 hectares of silvopastoral systems, 226 hectares of agroforestry and 50 rainwater-harvesting systems, including in Santa María basin.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Results obtained, Result 2, paragraphs beginning ‘El programa desarrolló’ and ‘Se elaboró’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2023-06-27 reports: The programme reports eight climate-resilient water-management instruments, including vulnerability studies, adaptation plans, hydrological balances and environmental flows, plus soil-climate zoning for 12 priority crops.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Results obtained, Result 3, paragraphs beginning ‘Se fortaleció’ and ‘Se implementaron’.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2023-06-27 reports: The programme reports over 40 agrometeorological and hydrological stations, two flood early-warning systems in priority basins and advice for over 6,000 producers across five regions.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
